topic: Is the Snowdon Ranger path up Snowdon open, and how long does it take?

text: @claude Is the Snowdon Ranger path up Snowdon open, and how long does it take?

I couldn't confirm the current status. I found no closure notice for the Snowdon Ranger path, but nothing live either, so check the [Eryri National Park website](https://www.eryri.llyw.cymru/walk/snowdon-ranger/) before you go. It's late November, so expect winter conditions up high.

Timing: about 6 km one way, roughly 3 to 3.5 hours up. The [Eryri National Park Authority leaflet](https://eryri.gov.wales/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/SNPA_SnowdonRanger_EN.pdf) gives about 6 hours for the 13 km round trip, not counting stops.

@claude do rental cars from manchester airport in december usually need winter tyres or snow chains for snowdonia? and roughly what's a 3-day hire for 10-13 dec

Usually no. The UK has no winter tyre or chain requirement, and Manchester hire cars normally come on standard all-season or summer tyres. Budget says it doesn't supply winter tyres, and Avis lists chains and snow tyres only as paid extras. You'd rarely need them on the main roads to Llanberis.

I couldn't find a real quote for 10-13 Dec. Sites show average prices of about £17-20 a day, but that's for January and the cheap end. I'd guess £25-45 a day for 3 days, so roughly £75-135 before extras and young-driver fees. Check a live quote on Discover Cars or Avis.

Sources: Budget FAQ, Avis winter equipment page, Discover Cars, Rentcars.
